The Perceptual Quality Auditor's finding of 'slight compression' is negligible compared to the structural issues.

All key visual components (3 wheels, handlebars, seat, pedals) are present and recognizable. The structural defects do not obscure the class identity, hence the high alignment score.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from significant structural artifacts typical of AI-generated mechanical objects. The front wheel hub/pedal assembly is physically impossible (cranks floating/merging into the fender), warranting a low artifact score. The rear basket melts into the seat. Grounding is weak. These are not just texture issues but fundamental geometric failures, preventing a higher artifact score despite the clean overall appearance.
